How the Food tab works

Search bar
Type a food (Egg, Water bottle, Skim milk) and tap it. Then pick the egg size or how many ml you had, and press Add. Your last choice is remembered and pre-selected next time.

Your goals
Calories, protein, fat and water targets come from your age, height, weight and your Cut / Maintain / Bulk goal.

Calories & Fat
The bar fills red to green up to a healthy minimum, then stays full and fades toward orange as you near the max. It turns red past the max (on a bulk, calories are a floor to hit instead).

Protein & Water
These are floors: the bar goes red to green as you close in on the goal and stays green once hit. Water bottles count fully, and milk counts about 90% as water.

Today's summary
Lists everything you logged. Tap the × on an item to remove a mistake.

Settings
Delete account?

This permanently deletes your account, your name and all of your progress. This can't be undone.
